title: Second responsiveness round: timeline and presentation improvements
scope: 30 new production responsiveness/render improvements. Startup and editor lazy-loading, and the earlier 74 implemented candidates, are excluded. Distinct avoided work is documented without attributing an aggregate Electron speedup to individual helpers.

entries.title: Retain timeline recording/automation track counts
entries.evidence: Thirty unrelated React publications perform zero repeated track-type reads; one combined audio-track pass replaces two filter allocations.
entries.limitations: Relevant track, armed-control and automation membership edits recompute.

entries.title: Retain timeline frequency-ruler presence
entries.evidence: Thirty unrelated publications perform zero repeated display-mode scans.
entries.limitations: Display mode and ruler visibility changes invalidate.

entries.title: Retain output dock content height
entries.evidence: Thirty unrelated publications perform zero repeated bus collapsed-state reads.
entries.limitations: Bus replacement and configured row-height changes invalidate.

entries.title: Retain total timeline lane height
entries.evidence: Thirty unrelated publications perform zero repeat lane-height callback invocations.
entries.limitations: Resize, auto-fit and recording/automation controls remain dependencies.

entries.title: Retain time-selection identity from frame endpoints
entries.evidence: Selection object stays identical over thirty unrelated renders, preventing selection-dependent ruler/canvas effects.
entries.limitations: Conversion retains owning framesToSeconds rounding and bounds.

entries.title: Prune waveform caches only on clip-membership publications
entries.evidence: Thirty unrelated publications perform zero repeated waveform-cache enumerations; removed clips are deleted.
entries.limitations: Cleanup occurs after commit; source/track index replacement can also invalidate membership.

entries.title: Retain ruler scale from timing authority
entries.evidence: Replacing the containing project thirty times preserves ruler-scale identity and its downstream tick memo.
entries.limitations: Time display, tempo, signature, sequences and primary-sequence changes invalidate.

entries.title: Reuse one crossfade overlap analysis
entries.evidence: Range preparation accepts owner-supplied overlaps with zero repeat start/duration accessor reads; exact range parity passes.
entries.limitations: Existing independent callers retain the original analysis fallback.

entries.title: Separate annotation timing/order preparation from selection
entries.evidence: Thirty selection/focus publications perform zero repeat annotation timing reads, validation/sort/Intl preparation.
entries.limitations: New annotation snapshots and locale/time-authority changes prepare again.

entries.title: Index annotation viewport queries
entries.evidence: Queries inspect fewer than twenty exact-geometry candidates among ten thousand annotations, preserving order, tiny-region width, marker margins and retained focus.
entries.limitations: Small sets retain the ordinary one-pass visibility path.

entries.title: Coalesce hover-indicator layout reads to a display frame
entries.evidence: Ten raw pointer samples create one pending RAF and two rectangle reads using the latest coordinates.
entries.limitations: One display-frame hover delay; hide cancels pending work.

entries.title: Suppress repeated hover-indicator DOM mutations
entries.evidence: An unchanged position and visibility perform zero hidden/style writes; geometry reads precede mutations.
entries.limitations: Changed coordinates continue updating both indicators.

entries.title: Coalesce annotation drag previews with a final flush
entries.evidence: Three raw moves create one RAF and one React commit; release flushes the latest delta and cancellation discards it.
entries.limitations: At most one display-frame preview delay; committed delta remains exact.

entries.title: Skip unchanged annotation drag deltas
entries.evidence: Repeating the quantized delta creates no additional React commit.
entries.limitations: New deltas and new gestures still publish.

entries.title: Exclude ordinary waveform rows from FFT subscriptions
entries.evidence: Ordinary waveform rows subscribe zero listeners and receive zero FFT-triggered rerenders; entering FFT view reads the current revision.
entries.limitations: Spectrogram and multiview rows retain subscriptions and preparation updates.

entries.title: Retain normalized row spectrogram options
entries.evidence: The fallback normalization/frozen options object is prepared only when its settings or sample-rate dependencies change.
entries.limitations: A companion draw-key memo is uncounted; no FFT/raster behavior changes.

entries.title: Restrict and retain clip fade geometry
entries.evidence: Two thousand inactive unselected clips skip curve geometry; selecting one keeps existing faded-clip geometry without extra shape reads.
entries.limitations: Immutable row projection identity and viewport geometry own cache invalidation.

entries.title: Skip fade portal discovery for empty eligible sets
entries.evidence: Rows with zero eligible fades/selected audio clips perform zero data-clip-id DOM discovery; targets retain only eligible IDs.
entries.limitations: When eligible clips appear, committed DOM discovery resumes.

entries.title: Index loop-overlay DOM clip lookup
entries.evidence: One clipById construction replaces per-target clips.find scans, changing target resolution from quadratic to linear work.
entries.limitations: DOM discovery remains necessary after selection changes that mount trim handles.

entries.title: Suppress unchanged loop-trim inline writes
entries.evidence: Repeated placement writes zero right/visibility properties; shrinking repeats resets the properties.
entries.limitations: Loop boundaries and trim hit-target semantics remain unchanged.

entries.title: Retain loop boundary and normalization presentation
entries.evidence: Selection-only renders reuse normalized period/source geometry and visible loop-boundary arrays.
entries.limitations: Clip/window/zoom/rate changes rebuild; keyboard source restoration remains covered.

entries.title: Retain automation SVG path strings
entries.evidence: Thirty unrelated publications perform zero repeat sample-coordinate reads or path-string construction.
entries.limitations: Changing projected spans recomputes exact original SVG paths.

entries.title: Retain automation point deduplication
entries.evidence: Thirty unrelated publications perform zero repeated authored-point-list reads and retain handle model identity.
entries.limitations: Changed spans preserve first-authored-point identity through the original deduplicator.

entries.title: Retain automation target groups
entries.evidence: Thirty disabled/control-state publications perform zero repeated target group-label reads.
entries.limitations: Target-array replacement regroups; disabled-reason and mode semantics remain covered.

entries.title: Retain static audio-track ruler children
entries.evidence: Thirty unrelated control publications retain exact React child elements, avoiding child-ruler reexecution and tick preparation.
entries.limitations: Channel heights, scale, range, format and zoom invalidate; inactive ruler kinds are omitted.

entries.title: Index video-thumbnail timestamp matching
entries.evidence: One hundred timestamp lookups against ten thousand catalog entries perform zero repeat timestamp-property reads; authored-first and strict 0.05-second tolerance parity passes.
entries.limitations: Immutable catalog snapshot identity owns invalidation; direct index strings/maps/callbacks retain their precedence.

entries.title: Retain video rate-badge timing derivation
entries.evidence: Rate badge rational timing/BigInt preparation runs only when clip/source/rate dependencies change, instead of every exact-thumbnail publication.
entries.limitations: No project or raster timing speedup is claimed from this memo alone.

entries.title: Prepare audio-row shared model inputs in one pass
entries.evidence: Two hundred clips resolve shared track color with two coercions instead of four hundred; shared geometry/selection/render flags and envelope previews avoid the second mapped array.
entries.limitations: Per-clip waveform projection and colors remain independent; recording previews retain existing conversion.

entries.title: Retain filmstrip cell geometry and labels
entries.evidence: Thirty unrelated publications perform zero repeated thumbnail-frame reads, rectangle preparation or timestamp formatting.
entries.limitations: Viewport/zoom/rate changes preserve existing frame rounding and regenerate cells.

entries.title: Retain document duration across unrelated project publications
entries.evidence: Thirty unrelated project replacements perform zero repeated document-duration calculations; primary-sequence switching explicitly invalidates.
entries.limitations: Clip/track/time-authority/schema/runtime-version/project-rate changes invalidate; recording previews remain a separate duration maximum.

verification.focusedNodeTests: Passing correctness, React commit/identity, and accessor/write-count probes; existing annotation, loop/fade, waveform raster/attachment, automation and video/image component regressions pass.
verification.typeScript: npx tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --pretty false passes, including new strict TypeScript tests and helpers.
verification.lint: npm run lint:changed passes; canonical and final post-commit verification is owned by the root.
verification.browserAndElectron: Root owns canonical gate, build, browser workflows and Electron default-Speed comparisons.
